instruction: Enable automatic message checking for new mail on the primary email account in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic new mail checking for server1 (the primary email account). The evaluator checks that mail.server.server1.check_new_mail is set to true. Current value in profile is false, so agent needs to change it to true. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.
metadata.verification: Verified by reading prefs.js from cache: mail.server.server1.check_new_mail is currently false. Task asks to enable automatic checking (value should be true).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies and checks the specific Thunderbird preference (mail.server.server1.check_new_mail) required for automatic new mail checking
Getter (get_vm_file) properly extracts the prefs.js file from VM to local cache for analysis
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js using regex and validates the preference value against expected rule
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring all in-memory changes are flushed to disk
Expected value (true) is semantically correct for enabling automatic checking, and comparison method (eq) is appropriate
Edge cases properly handled: file missing returns None (metric returns 0.0), preference key missing results in False
Complete instruction coverage: single requirement to enable automatic checking is fully verified
Static type warning about Union return type is not a runtime issue - metric correctly handles None case

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
